title: Hearty Spicy Middle Eastern Bread Fattoush
description: A tangy and pillowy Middle Eastern dish featuring cayenne pepper and flambe, perfect for a brunch mood, with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toss the pita bread cubes with 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toast in the oven for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, cucumber, tomato, red onion, and feta cheese.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, garlic, cayenne pepper, and sumac.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Add the toasted pita bread cubes to the salad and toss again.
Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a small skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Pour the garlic oil over the salad and serve immediately.
Flambe the salad with a small amount of olive oil for a smoky flavor.
